description:
*** OPEN VIEWING SATURDAY 3rd OCTOBER 11 - 11.30am***

23 Lavender Court, Forest Hill, Carrigaline, Co. Cork P43 A003

3 Bed Semi-Detached House | Guide Price €465,000| BER [A3] | c. [115] sq.m 

Dan Howard & Co. Ltd. is delighted to present 23 Lavender Court to the market — a bright and well-maintained three bedroom semi-detached family home in one of Carrigaline's most established and sought-after residential developments.

Positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac setting within Forest Hill, the property has been well cared for by its current owners and is presented in turnkey condition throughout. Accommodation is laid out over two floors and comprises an entrance hallway, front living room, kitchen/dining room & TV room to the rear, with access to the garden, and a guest w.c. at ground floor level. Upstairs there are three bedrooms, with the master benefitting from ensuite facilities, along with a family bathroom.

Externally, the property offers off-street parking to the front with a cobble-locked driveway, while to the rear there is a private, south/west-facing garden laid out in lawn with a paved patio area — ideal for family use and outdoor entertaining.

Forest Hill is a mature development within easy walking distance of Carrigaline town centre, schools, shops and the Owenabue riverside walkway, making this an ideal home for first time buyers, families and investors alike.

Viewing comes highly recommended.

Walking distance to Carrigaline town centre and schools

LOCATION

 Forest Hill is one of Carrigaline's most popular and well-established residential areas, ideally located just off the Ferney Road.

 Within walking distance of Carrigaline town centre with its full range of shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and services.

 Excellent choice of schools nearby including Carrigaline Community School, Gaelscoil Charraig Uí Leighin, ERC and Educate Together

 Regular 220 bus service to Cork city centre and Ballincollig.

 Approx. 10 minutes to Cork Airport, 15 minutes to Cork city centre, and convenient to Ringaskiddy, Carrigtwohill and the N40 South Ring Road.

 Close to Crosshaven, Fountainstown and Myrtleville beaches, with Carrigaline GAA, rugby and soccer clubs, the Owenabue riverside walk and Fernhill Golf & Country Club all close at hand.
